name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-copilot-apps-copilot-star-match-game
title: Copilot Star Match Game
shortDescription: A SharePoint Copilot app that enables teams to play the Star Match game.
longDescription: Copilot Star Match Game demonstrates a SharePoint Framework-based Copilot Agent that helps teams play the Star Match game. This solution leverages interactive game mechanics, enabling engaging and fun experiences within Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and other Microsoft 365 applications.
